name: Numbered item
summary: The numbered wrapper for a repeatable composite item — a grey card with a muted number chip, a "<Label> N" header, a hover delete, and a body slot (SETTINGS-43).
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-numbered-item> — the wrapper for a repeatable COMPOSITE item (a Question, a Card, a Round): its own body of fields (in the slot) under a number chip + "<Label> N" header + hover delete (SETTINGS-43). The `contained` variant (default) wraps the WHOLE item — chip, header, delete AND body — inside ONE secondary-fill grey card (never a header sitting above a separately-grey body); the number chip is a MUTED GREY circle (never a radical-purple badge). The delete is a TERTIARY text trash (borderless, non-danger) shown ONLY on hover with its space reserved, hidden entirely for a non-removable item (`deletable=false`) and disabled at the minimum count (`candelete=false`). The `plain` variant drops the fill and is for SINGLE-FIELD items only. Delete glyph by name via <aha-icon>. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. Emits composed `delete`.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. The item's fields go in the default slot. React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively.

props.name: variant
props.desc: contained = grey card (composite items); plain = no fill (single-field items only)

props.name: n
props.desc: The item's number, shown in the chip and the header

props.name: deletable
props.desc: Show the hover delete; omit / false hides it entirely

props.name: candelete
props.desc: false disables the delete (at the minimum item count) without hiding it

props.name: delete
props.desc: Composed event when the delete is pressed; read e.detail.n

whenToUse.when: a repeatable COMPOSITE item — more than one field, or a nested option list (a Question, a Card, a Round)
a flat list of single values — not wrapped in a numbered card
a single-field repeatable item that does not warrant a grey card

opinion.note: This is the ONE exception to "never a container around settings" (SETTINGS-15): it wraps a repeatable composite item, not plain settings. A composite item must keep the contained grey card — dropping the fill (plain, or a hand-rolled header over a fill-less body) is a build mistake (SETTINGS-43). The chip is muted grey, never a purple badge.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab NumberedItem control mapped into the DS. The grey card, muted chip and tertiary hover delete are the settings-specific composite-item wrapper (SETTINGS-43), reusing DS V3 secondary-fill + tertiary-button tokens.
